newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil business group backs Cardoso re-election.
newsitem.headline: Brazil business group backs Cardoso re-election.

text.p: Brazil's business community backs the idea of re-election for President Fernando Henrique Cardoso and will lobby deputies to approve a constitutional amendment opening up that possibilty, an industry head said.
Ninety percent of businessmen in Sao Paulo state are in favor of a second Cardoso term, Carlos Eduardo Moreira Ferreira, the president of the Sao Paulo Industry Federation (Fiesp) said.
The figure was included in a poll carried out by Fiesp and due to be made public later on Monday, he told reporters.
